_doc: Revert-verify mutants for issue #4551 / req 60ed88e7 (vault-exodev task c223e6ef, RFC 14217015 P1.5): a SPARQL BIND extends the group prefix at its position. Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct within the spec). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › Bn @req` (ITRV §A44/§A104). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145). Subject: PatternTranslator.translateWhere / translateBind.

PT1_later_bind_dropped._note: A BIND after the first group element no longer extends the prefix (it vanishes). B24 (review round 2): the dropped BIND is the one that defines ?s, so the UUID rewrite injects into `?s ?p ?o` alone — a cross product with the label rows. Review round 3: B25 — its `BIND(IF(EXISTS …) AS ?v)` follows a pattern and vanishes, ?v is unbound; B31 — both BINDs of ?n follow a pattern, the reference loses its rows; B32 — the BIND after the label pattern vanishes, the group has no Extend, so the UUID injection runs and leaves the subquery / UNION / VALUES operand unconstrained (the old injection defect).

PT2_first_bind_dropped._note: A BIND as the FIRST group element is dropped (the empty group stands in). Review round 3: B28/B29/B30 open with the BIND of ?window / ?w; dropped, it leaves the variable unbound and the reference rows vanish.
PT2_first_bind_dropped.from: result = this.translateBind(first, { type: "bgp", triples: [] } as BGPOperation);

PT3_filters_positional._note: FILTERs are translated in place (joined as Filter(∅)) instead of group-scoped at the end. B14 is NOT in the set, by mechanism: AlgebraOptimizer.eliminateEmptyBGPInFilterJoin rewrites `Join(X, Filter(∅, e))` back to the group-level `Filter(X, e)`, so a positional FILTER that FOLLOWS the prefix is repaired by the optimizer (a second barrier); only a FILTER first in the group escapes it (Join(Filter(∅), …) under an Extend is never recursed) — B4. B20 (added after review round 1): the mutant leaves each FILTER both in place AND at group level (filterPatterns is still applied at the end), so the filter runs twice; the UUID-index rewrite (optimizeWithSubjects) drops only the OUTER copy and replaces ?s with the IRI, and the inner copy then reads an unbound ?s — 0 rows with and without the BIND, which trips the axis's `input is built` guard. B24 (review round 2): run-verified that the axis trips its `input is built` guard (expected = 0). By reading: with the BIND defining ?s the UUID rewrite falls back to a VALUES join for the OUTER filter copy, and the bind join then substitutes ?s into the INNER copy's STR(?s) — a substituted IRI is not an evaluable expression node (bug 4e3ce943), so every row is dropped. B32 (review round 3): the positional FILTER copy stays inside the join; the UUID rewrite replaces only the outer copy with a VALUES join, whose bind join then substitutes the IRI into the inner copy's expression and drops every row (bug 4e3ce943).

PT4_iri_marker_dropped._note: BIND(<iri>) is no longer marked: it binds the IRI's string, which never joins with a stored IRI.
PT4_iri_marker_dropped.from: expression: writtenAsIri && expression.type === "literal" ? { ...expression, iri: true } : expression,
